_help: Shop details used across the website. Edit on GitHub, commit, and the site rebuilds in about 2 minutes. Anything in [square brackets] is a placeholder that must be replaced before launch.
_orderModeHelp: orderMode: "whatsapp" = phase 1: no prices, the cart is sent to you as a WhatsApp message (works on GitHub Pages). "checkout" = phase 2: prices, live stock and full checkout (needs Cloudflare + Google Sheets, see README).
name: oneMore
_upiHelp: The UPI ID customers pay to is set in the Payment tab of the private Orders sheet (every change is emailed to the owner). upiId and upiNameCustomersSee here are only the fallback when that tab is empty.
upiNameCustomersSee: [exact name shown in the customer's UPI app]
